injuries.comment: Wilson is undergoing surgery for a fractured right hand and will miss at least four to six weeks, per Shams Charania of ESPN.
The Bulls reported Powell to be re-evaluated later this week due to a hamstring injury.
Tomlin will remain on the inactive list for Wednesday's game against the Grizzlies.
The Cavaliers reported Mobley to miss at least 7-10 days due to a toe injury.
